provenance.terrain: NASA LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (PGDA product 90, Barker et al. 2023): horizon, slope, elevation
provenance.psr: NASA LOLA LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ_1km2 (PGDA product 90), polygons >= 10 km2 used for distance
provenance.regions: Artemis candidate landing regions, vertices read from NASA Quickmap layer "A3: Candidate Landing Regions 2022"
provenance.sun_earth: astropy built-in ephemeris + IAU 2009 lunar rotation model; approximate, not SPICE/Horizons
provenance.candidates: 12 points per region: 4 best-lit plus an even spread, slope <= 15 deg, outside PSRs
